audit_policy.community_policy: Community material can reveal implementation failure modes but is not proof of profitability.
audit_policy.performance_claim_policy: No public backtest or trader claim is accepted as evidence of edge without reproducible costs and strict-forward OOS.
audit_policy.mutation_policy: No strategy, parameter, registry, router, service, shadow, paper, live, or order mutation in this stage.

strategies.canonical_identity: Original Turtle complete trend-following system: System 1 20-day breakout with prior-winner filter and 55-day failsafe; System 2 55-day breakout; N-based unit sizing; 0.5N adds up to four units; 2N stops; 10/20-day opposite breakout exits; portfolio heat limits.
matched_dimensions: pyramiding count is capped at four
material_deviations: System 2 55-day entry and 55-day failsafe are absent
System 1 prior-winning-breakout skip rule is absent
EMA20/EMA55 trend filter is added although the original entry is price breakout based
position size uses fixed long/short fractions rather than account-risk divided by N and contract value
adds occur at 0.80 ATR and on EMA dip reclaim; original adds occur every 0.5N only after favorable movement
fixed 2.6R/3.2R profit targets replace 10-day/20-day opposite breakout exits and uncapped trend capture
portfolio correlation and directional unit limits are absent
short signals are generated by the legacy function but converted to HOLD by the LBot adapter
strategies.identity_action: Do not call the current implementation a complete Turtle system. Preserve as immutable legacy approximation and create an authenticity child only after a full Turtle state machine and portfolio-risk contract exist.
minimum_authentic_child_spec: N-based unit sizing from account equity and instrument point value
10-day and 20-day opposite-channel exits without fixed profit target
market-group and total directional heat limits
strategies.replay_requirement: Daily-equivalent horizon or explicit bar-to-session conversion; long and short; multi-market portfolio replay; segment-end forced close prohibited as a performance exit.

strategies.canonical_identity: R-Breaker session strategy using previous-session high, low, and close to calculate six ordered levels: breakout buy, setup sell, enter sell, enter buy, setup buy, breakout sell; reversal entries require an observation excursion before reversal; breakout and reversal modes share a session state machine.

primary_sources.title: R-Breaker six-level formula and session logic

matched_dimensions: both breakout and reversal branches exist
long and short signal geometry exists
a central reference level is calculated
material_deviations: uses a rolling 48-bar high/low and last close instead of previous-session HLC
uses custom breakout_mult=0.30 and reversal_mult=0.50 rather than the six canonical R-Breaker formulas
does not calculate or preserve all six ordered levels
reversal does not require the canonical observe/setup excursion followed by enter-level reversal sequence
session boundary and session reset state are absent
EMA21/EMA55 trend filter, chase filter, fixed R targets, scale-in, retest add, and reduce logic are ZEL additions
short signals are suppressed by the long-only LBot core
strategies.identity_action: Keep rbreaker_like as an explicitly synthetic derivative. A separate rbreaker_authentic child must implement previous-session six-level formulas and stateful reversal sequencing before any comparison.
minimum_authentic_child_spec: breakout mode and reversal mode arbitration
session close and stop behavior specified without arbitrary fixed RR optimization
strategies.replay_requirement: Session-aware intraday bars with no cross-session leakage; previous-session levels frozen before the current session; long and short.

strategies.canonical_identity: TTM Squeeze volatility and momentum framework: Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channels identify compression; first release marks firing; a smoothed momentum histogram based on Donchian midpoint, SMA, and linear regression determines direction and weakening momentum can inform exits.
matched_dimensions: squeeze on when Bollinger Bands are inside Keltner Channels
release is previous squeeze on followed by squeeze off
material_deviations: the TTM momentum histogram is absent
direction is inferred from an EMA34 slope and an immediate close outside a Bollinger Band
Keltner construction uses EMA(close) plus ATR, while the selected TTM reference specifies the original Keltner construction for this indicator
requires release and band break on the same bar, which is not the canonical first-green-dot plus momentum-direction rule
fixed R targets, chase filter, impulse threshold, retest adds, scale-ins, and failure reductions are ZEL additions
short signals are suppressed by the long-only LBot core
strategies.identity_action: Preserve current version as squeeze_break_legacy. Build a formula-locked TTM child with an explicit Keltner variant and momentum histogram before testing additional ZEL filters.
minimum_authentic_child_spec: locked Bollinger and Keltner formula versions
long direction only when momentum is above zero and rising
short direction only when momentum is below zero and falling
exit/decay rule separated from entry formula
strategies.replay_requirement: Per-timeframe compression-release event replay; event uniqueness; no parameter search before strict-forward gross-edge gate.

strategies.canonical_identity: Olivier Seban Supertrend is an ATR-based recursive trend line. The common platform strategy changes long when the Supertrend flips below price and short when it flips above price. A pullback strategy is a derivative and must define its additional rules separately.
matched_dimensions: HL2 plus or minus ATR multiplier basic bands
recursive final upper and lower bands
material_deviations: entry is not the reference Supertrend flip strategy
EMA50 slope, ten-bar swing, 50-percent pullback level, reclaim thresholds, and candle filters define a ZEL derivative
fixed 2.4R/3.0R targets and add/dip-add logic are not part of the reference indicator strategy
no explicit exit on opposite Supertrend flip is emitted
short signals are suppressed by the long-only LBot core
strategies.identity_action: Formula may be retained, but strategy identity must be explicit: supertrend_pullback is a ZEL derivative, not the canonical Supertrend flip strategy. Test the formula-locked flip baseline separately before judging the derivative.
minimum_authentic_child_spec: exit or reverse on opposite flip
no EMA, swing, reclaim, fixed target, or add rule in the baseline
strategies.replay_requirement: Compare formula-locked flip baseline against pullback derivative on identical untouched OOS; report incremental contribution of each added rule.

strategies.canonical_identity: Bollinger Bands are a relative high/low and pattern framework. Band tags are not signals, closes outside are initially continuation signals, and reversal use requires pattern recognition or independent confirmation plus regime context.

primary_sources.title: John Bollinger official Bollinger Band Rules

matched_dimensions: RSI is used as a separate confirmation input
EMA direction attempts to avoid direct countertrend entries
middle-band distance participates in target construction
material_deviations: entry still treats a close outside the band plus oscillator extreme as immediate mean-reversion evidence
official rule states band tags are not signals and outside closes initially imply continuation
no W-bottom, M-top, percent-b, bandwidth, or explicit range-regime state is implemented
same-bar reclaim is merely movement versus previous close, not a confirmed return through the band or structural reversal
water-add behavior increases exposure after another extreme condition
fixed R targets and very narrow ATR stops are ZEL additions
short signals are suppressed by the long-only LBot core
strategies.identity_action: Do not claim creator-rule fidelity. Preserve the legacy oscillator fade and create separate explicit baselines: creator-pattern reversal and volatility-breakout continuation.
minimum_authentic_child_spec: confirmed W-bottom or M-top geometry or another independent non-correlated confirmation
return-inside-band confirmation separated from initial outside close
percent-b and bandwidth available for diagnostics
strategies.replay_requirement: Separate reversal and continuation hypotheses; never combine their trades; evaluate trend-walk losses and range-only edge by strict-forward regime folds.

common_defects: short signals generated but suppressed at LBot adapter
fixed profit targets replace native trend or state exits
fixed long and short sizes replace strategy-native risk sizing
ZEL beam/add/retest/dip logic injected before baseline edge was established
single common replay harness cannot represent session, portfolio, and event-state requirements
